title: Privacy policy
description: Processing of personal data in Solaria.

blocks.text: This page will organize information about the processing of personal data related to the use of Solaria. The people responsible for the service must confirm the practices described before the final policy is published.
Identification of the controller
The identification of the data controller still needs to be confirmed.
Channels for privacy requests
The appropriate channels for privacy requests also need to be confirmed.
What data is processed
This section must explain which personal data is received, provided or generated while using the services.
Source of the information
It must also indicate where this information comes from.
Categories and processing situations
The categories of data and the situations in which they are processed depend on the review of the product's actual flows.
Purposes
The final policy must explain why the data is processed.
Legal bases
It must indicate the legal bases that apply to each purpose, according to the verified practices and the legal review.
Recipients and service providers
This section must identify the categories of recipients and service providers and the purposes of the sharing.
International transfers
Any international transfers must be described, where applicable.
Data accessed and purpose
The information about integrations, including Google Calendar, must describe the data accessed and the purpose of the access.
Managing or revoking authorization
It must also explain how users can manage or revoke the authorization, according to the integration actually implemented.
Storage and security
The information about storage and security measures must reflect the processes actually adopted.
Retention and deletion
Retention and deletion periods must also reflect the processes adopted. These points are awaiting confirmation.
Rights of data subjects
The final version must inform the rights that apply to data subjects.
How to submit requests
It must explain how to submit requests for access, correction or deletion, among others provided for by law. The procedure and the responsible channel are yet to be defined.
Privacy channel
The privacy channel will be announced after the policy is defined and approved.
Update date and versions
The update date and the version history will be announced after the policy is defined and approved.
